HarfBuzz 14.3.0 -- the text SHAPER (MIT-style, see COPYING)

Source:   https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/releases/tag/14.3.0
Asset:    harfbuzz-14.3.0.tar.xz (19,819,024 bytes)
SHA-256:  16070d77cfc4ba1f1e7327e83bf9b3f55898081cabdb94e56a33e04fc8874eae

Vendored (GR2 of SOFTANZA_GRAPHICS_PLAN.md): the SHAPER closure only --
src/*.cc *.hh *.h from the tarball, the OT/ source tree, and the
hb-subset*.hh/.h HEADERS (hb-open-type.hh includes them), but NOT the
subset .cc implementations, the graph/ repacker, tools, tests, or the
python generators. ONE translation unit builds it all:

    zig c++ -c vendor/harfbuzz/harfbuzz.cc -O2 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti

(~49 s on the dev machine, zero errors -- proven in GR0 before vendoring,
re-proven from this tree.) No cmake, no SDK, no config header: harfbuzz.cc
carries its own OT shaper and defaults every optional backend (freetype,
glib, graphite2, coretext, directwrite, gdi) to OFF unless HAVE_* macros
say otherwise -- we define none.

The fixture SUBSETTER (hb-subset) is deliberately NOT vendored: the
committed Arabic subset font under base/test/gpu/fixtures/ is generated
by engine/tools/font_subset_gen.c, which compiles harfbuzz-subset.cc
from THIS SAME pinned tarball at regeneration time (see the tool header).
CI never regenerates; it uses the committed fixture.

Why the largest C++ vendor in the house is justified: OpenType shaping
(Arabic joining, mandatory ligatures, GSUB/GPOS) is a decade-deep
specialty; writing a shaper was REJECTED in the plan of record --
presentation-forms tricks produce WRONG Arabic on modern fonts. This is
exactly what wise vendoring is for.
